omitted_costs: later history growth,88 extra prompt tokens per observed request,initial loading,actual decode,short first calls,negative/recovery,long-output and normal cleanup; simultaneous owner time is not added as wall time
shared_client_deadline: min(auto client start+20500s, same-host actual service monotonic deadline-30s)
phase_timeout: min(regular20500 or long9000, remaining of that SAME shared client deadline); no positive remaining -> FAIL and stop
failure_policy: No skipped acceptance case promotion, no output clamp/crop, no fake progress or automatic reload; exhausted time is a real failed attempt with owned-handle and normal cleanup evidence where achieved
